title: Hagibis Verde okra: Characteristics
metaDescription: Hagibis Verde okra is an okra variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Hagibis Verde is an okra variety. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Hagibis Verde okra is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [okra variety finder](/crop-varieties/okra), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit okra fields most often: [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 45 to 50 days after sowing.
Tolerant to anthracnose, downy mildew and powdery mildew (seller's claim).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: ramgo's second okra beside Smooth Green, only the seller's page found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual okra on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Hagibis Verde okra

Buyers want smooth, dark green pods picked young. Pick a variety that stays tender a day longer on the plant, because okra turns woody fast in the heat. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.
